ideas.title: Investigating Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of 'ghost' daycare centers in Minnesota and the misuse of federal funds
questions: How widespread is the problem of 'ghost' daycare centers in Minnesota?
How much federal funding has been misused?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and highlight the need for increased oversight of federal funds. I recommend starting with an analysis of federal funding allocations for daycare programs in Minnesota and then investigating the management of those programs.

ideas.title: The Epstein Investigation: What's Next?
ideas.description: Investigate the conclusion of the Epstein investigation and the release of millions of files
questions: What do the released files reveal about Epstein's activities?
How will the conclusion of the investigation impact future investigations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to provide insight into the handling of high-profile investigations and the need for transparency. I recommend starting with an analysis of the released files and then investigating the implications of the investigation's conclusion.
